policy: Research/source leads only; no global merchant trust, product origin guarantee or geography risk weight.

outlets.name: Competition Bureau
outlets.summary: Non-food Canadian origin claims: qualified Made in Canada and Product of Canada have different tests.
outlets.limit: Neither threshold establishes 100% regional inputs, seller or dispatch.

outlets.name: Canadian Food Inspection Agency
outlets.summary: Food origin guidance is distinct from non-food cost guidelines.
outlets.limit: Food-origin claims may allow minor imported inputs and imported packaging.

outlets.name: Federal Trade Commission
outlets.summary: Unqualified Made in USA requires all or virtually all domestic content and processing.
outlets.limit: Negligible foreign content may be allowed; no seller/dispatch proof.

outlets.name: Secretaría de Economía / Hecho en México
outlets.summary: 2025 certification rules allow manufacture in Mexico regardless of input origin.
outlets.limit: Mark authorization is not a bill of materials or an all-regional guarantee.

outlets.name: INEGI DENUE
outlets.summary: Establishment identity, activity and location discovery; API requires registration token.
outlets.limit: An establishment record cannot authenticate a product, seller affiliation or material origin. No API integrated.

outlets.name: PROFECO virtual-store monitoring
outlets.summary: Consumer lookup of dated online-store disclosure checks.
outlets.limit: Results have commercial/advertising reuse restrictions. Link only; no copied ratings, endorsements or trust badge.

outlets.name: ISED company directories
outlets.summary: Government portal links to Canadian supplier directories.
outlets.limit: Listed firms need exact entity and product verification; directory is not certification.

outlets.name: US OTEXA sourcing directory
outlets.summary: US textile/apparel/footwear supply-chain vendors with a US manufacturing or assembly plant.
outlets.limit: Voluntary listings are not government endorsements or FTC compliance guarantees.

outlets.name: Thomas supplier discovery
outlets.summary: Thomas explains its North American business/contact/capability validation badge.
outlets.limit: Operating in North America does not establish all-regional input origin for every SKU.

outlets.name: Alliance for American Manufacturing directory
outlets.summary: Company discovery for domestic manufacturing operations.
outlets.limit: Relies on company information and expressly does not review individual product origin compliance.

outlets.name: Made in CA
outlets.summary: Independent Canadian product and business discovery with ownership/manufacture distinctions.
outlets.limit: Community/editorial information; verify exact products. No directory database copied.

outlets.name: Groupe Lacasse
outlets.summary: Manufacturer describes business/institutional furniture operations and Saint-Pie, Québec headquarters.
outlets.limit: Manufacturer lead only; materials, components, seller and shipping still require SKU-specific records.

outlets.name: Cinsa / Santa Anita
outlets.summary: Manufacturer describes Mexican enamelware/aluminium/porcelain production and brands.
outlets.limit: Brand-wide marketing cannot prove every component, packaging or selected retail listing.

outlets.name: Grupo Flexi
outlets.summary: Manufacturer history discloses footwear production/distribution, Quirelli and US retail expansion.
outlets.limit: History is not current stock or all-SKU origin evidence; verify seller and model.

outlets.name: Vitromex
outlets.summary: Manufacturer reports ceramic-covering production facilities in Mexican states.
outlets.limit: Plant presence is not all-local raw-material or exact tile/batch authentication.

outlets.name: Lodge Cast Iron
outlets.summary: Seasoned iron/steel and USA Enamel are distinguished from Essential Enamel imported from China or Vietnam.
outlets.limit: Mixed catalogue: never transfer a domestic claim across collections; exact SKU, packaging and fulfillment unknown.

outlets.name: Vermont Glove
outlets.summary: Maker describes glove manufacture in Randolph and an almost entirely domestic supply chain.
outlets.limit: Almost entirely is not 100%. Require complete component/packaging evidence.

outlets.name: DropCommerce
outlets.summary: Supplier network requires US/Canada dispatch and explicitly accepts overseas sourcing.
outlets.limit: Domestic supplier/warehouse status does not establish manufacturing origin.

outlets.name: Spocket
outlets.summary: Vancouver-based provider describes global supplier network and commerce integrations.
outlets.limit: Its supplier vetting is not DropShredder verification of every product or downstream store.

outlets.name: Syncee
outlets.summary: Canadian supplier discovery and major commerce-platform integrations.
outlets.limit: Ships-from filters and provider supplier reviews do not authenticate materials or exact seller ties.

outlets.name: Dropi import app
outlets.summary: Mexican-facing app discloses AliExpress, FForder, CJ and SourcinBox integrations.
outlets.limit: Do not conflate this import app with the separately documented Dropi logistics ecosystem.

outlets.name: Dropi logistics ecosystem
outlets.summary: Provider describes warehousing, inventory, packaging, carrier connections and Mexico coverage.
outlets.limit: Provider membership/logistics does not prove input origin or misconduct. MX site COD copy has Colombia wording; country-specific availability needs confirmation.

outlets.name: Tiendanube
outlets.summary: Official Dropi tutorial documents AliExpress imports, review import, Google Translate and inventory/order sync.
outlets.limit: Platform/CDN/template presence remains neutral; imported review provenance must be product-scoped.

outlets.name: Shopify
outlets.summary: Official guidance describes supplier-to-customer fulfillment and avoiding supplier ads/invoices in packages.
outlets.limit: Blind packaging and Shopify presence do not prove deception; verify actual seller claims and sources.

outlets.name: WooCommerce
outlets.summary: Official extension documentation describes supplier order notifications and blind packing slips.
outlets.limit: The platform also supports local suppliers; no hosting/platform-based risk inference.

outlets.name: CJdropshipping
outlets.summary: Provider describes China sourcing hubs plus partner overseas warehouses.
outlets.limit: Owned vs partner facilities and live SKU availability differ. No historic warehouse count treated as current inventory.

outlets.name: Nihaojewelry
outlets.summary: Provider states Hangzhou headquarters, Yiwu dispatch and China/Mexico warehouses with factory sourcing.
outlets.limit: Statements are provider disclosures; local Mexican inventory is not Mexican manufacturing.

outlets.name: SourcinBox
outlets.summary: Provider describes direct Chinese manufacturer/factory sourcing, customization and fulfillment.
outlets.limit: MX relevance is via Dropi app integration, not an independently established Mexican warehouse or merchant ownership.

outlets.name: HyperSKU
outlets.summary: Provider describes China supplier sourcing and customization.
outlets.limit: Cross-border research lead only; no Mexican/Canadian factory or warehouse asserted.

outlets.name: DSers
outlets.summary: Provider describes official AliExpress/Alibaba/1688 API order/import integrations.
outlets.limit: Tool presence cannot prove use by a particular storefront.

outlets.name: Printful
outlets.summary: Provider lists US, Toronto-area and Tijuana fulfillment; Mexico orders can be transferred for US domestic shipping.
outlets.limit: Printing/decoration and domestic first carrier label do not establish blank-material manufacture or first physical dispatch.

outlets.name: Canada West Boots
outlets.summary: Maker describes Winnipeg footwear production and an authorized retailer network; homepage states direct sales only through factory outlet.
outlets.limit: Check current authorized retailer links and exact boot model. Leather, sole, steel and packaging sources remain unverified.

outlets.name: Meyer Canada
outlets.summary: PEI cookware factory within a group that also discloses China, Thailand, Italy and US factories.
outlets.limit: Select the Canadian line and exact SKU; global company ownership and a PEI warehouse do not prove all-local metal/component sourcing.

outlets.name: Red Land Cotton
outlets.summary: Maker describes Alabama cotton and category-specific US spinning, weaving, dyeing, sewing and distribution routes.
outlets.limit: Substantive manufacturer disclosure, still not an independent BOM audit of every thread, fastener, package or selected shipment.

relationships.relation: provider history reports retail expansion from Mexico to US
